title: ReviewDecision
description: Governed outcome of one human review submitted from the Nebula Review Panel; corrections append and never rewrite the original assertion (master blueprint sections 75 and 125, ADR-0037, ADR-0057, ADR-0058; F0001-S0004).

action.description: ACCEPT, CORRECT, and REJECT are adjudications. BLOCKED is not: it records that the evidence could not be anchored, produces no assertion, and leaves the review item open (ADR-0058).

reason_code.description: Required for CORRECT, REJECT, and BLOCKED. EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED is the only reason code valid with BLOCKED.

evidence.description: The locator the reviewer actually saw, at the precision it was shown, carried onto any assertion this decision creates.

selector.description: W3C Web Annotation selectors, plus nebula:TableCellSelector as a declared local extension; character offsets are Unicode code points.

reviewer_principal_id.description: Resolved from the authenticated session, never from the request payload (ADR-0049, ADR-0057).

event_sha256.description: Hash of the submitted decision event; the idempotency key for resubmission of a batch.
